sections.note: المصدر يطبع هذا التمرين محلولًا؛ الصيغة المفرغة غير متوفرة في الملفات المرفقة.

items.q: أكمل الجملة السابقة باستخدام كلمات وعبارات من النصوص صفحة 19 (اجتماع واجبات ضباط الشرطة). الصيغة المفرغة غير مطبوعة، والمصدر يطبع الجمل الست محلولة:
items.answer:
1. Police officers can also direct traffic so that drivers stay safe.
2. Police officers use radar speed guns to make sure people are not driving too fast.
3. In a crime scene, they try to find evidence, like fingerprints and footprints.
4. They also interview witnesses who might have some important information related to the crime.
5. Police officers not only solve crimes but also prevent them.
6. For example, they watch crowded places where pickpockets might act.

items.answer: in crowded areas and places that sell expensive items, which might attract thieves

items.q: How can witnesses help the police?
items.answer: Witnesses can help the police by telling them what a criminal looks like or what time a crime was committed

items.q: What should you do if you are lost and need help?
items.answer: you can just ask a police officer for directions

items.answer: He likes solving crimes. He likes the feeling that he's helping people. He likes making his city a better place.

sections.title: التمرين 31/F – أكمل باستخدام (must, mustn't / have to, don't have to / need to, needn't)
sections.note: المصدر يطبع هذا التمرين محلولًا؛ الصيغة المفرغة غير متوفرة في الملفات المرفقة.

items.q: أكمل باستخدام (must, mustn't / have to, don't have to / need to, needn't). الصيغة المفرغة غير مطبوعة، والمصدر يطبع الجمل العشر محلولة (مع البدائل المقبولة):
items.answer:
1. When you get in a car, you must/have to/need to put on your seat belt.
2. There's petrol in the car, so you don't have to/needn't go to the petrol station.
3. You're driving too fast! You must/have to/need to slow down.
4. Please put out your cigarette. You mustn't smoke in the police station.
5. You don't have to/needn't pick me up in the car - I'll get the bus.
6. Police officers have to/must/need to prevent crimes.
7. I mustn't be back later than 8 o'clock tonight, or my parents will be angry.
8. Drivers mustn't go over the speed limit at any point.
9. Detectives in many countries don't have to/needn't wear a uniform, but traffic officers usually do.
10. If you see an accident, you must/have to/need to go to the police station and give a statement as a witness.

items.q: Write a short essay on the importance of road safety. Review Exercises A and B and look at the paragraph headings to help you organize your own ideas. Write 100–120 words.
items.answer:
Road Safety
Every year, thousands of people are killed in road accidents. Most accidents happen because drivers ignore basic safety rules. Therefore, road safety is very important for everyone.
Drivers should always carry their driving licence and check their brakes before driving. They should switch on their lights at night and park only in permitted areas. They should never exceed the speed limit, because speeding is very dangerous.
Drivers should also never leave their keys in the ignition or leave valuables inside their car. In conclusion, following road safety rules saves lives. Responsible driving is a duty, not a choice.

items.q: أكمل المقالتين باستخدام كلمات وعبارات من الصندوق. الصندوق: arrest, crime scene, disposed of, fingerprints, investigating, pickpocket, unattended, witness
items.answer:
Paragraph 1: The police got a call about a robbery last night. When they got to the crime scene, they found footprints and fingerprints they think were left by the criminal. They are still investigating the crime, but they think they will arrest someone soon.
Paragraph 2: Police caught a pickpocket who had stolen several wallets and mobile phones at the airport. The same man also stole some baggage that a passenger had left unattended in the waiting room while he bought a magazine. The thief had disposed of the stolen property when the police found him, but they spoke to a witness who said she had seen him steal the items.

items.q:
Ahmed wants to be a security guard. He is meeting the manager of a security company tomorrow morning at 9.00. It takes thirty minutes to go from his house to the security company. The manager sent him directions.
اكتب رسالة إلي أحمد تتكون من 100 إلي 120 كلمة تعطيه فيها نصيحة حول كيفية الحصول علي الوظيفة. استخدم (you should أو you shouldn't) في الرسالة خمس مرات علي الأقل، ويجب أن تكون الرسالة علي فقرتين.
items.answer:
A job Interview
Dear Ahmed,
I am glad to hear that you have a new interview tomorrow at 9.00 in the morning, and I want to give you some advice. You should leave your house no later than 8:00 AM to allow traffic. You shouldn't get lost on the way. You should arrive 10-15 minutes early, as the first impression is very important.
You should also dress formally and neatly for the meeting. Don't forget to take an extra copy of your CV. You should answer the questions confidently. I can't wait to hear about the result of the interview.
Best wishes,
Zaid
